payload.text: Bundle and remove the four 2026-10-08 container-run clones under ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/sp-2026-10-08/ctr/ (v1/t186, v1/t187, v2/t186, v3/t187), on hv's standing word that scratch clones go: bundle them into clone-archive, check every tip resolves from the bundle in a clone of the shared tree, then delete.
